rule:
(before any result was seen): a NEW bucket passes iff its consensus-disagreement rate is
≤ max(2 × old-corpus rate, old-corpus rate + 2 pp) AND its catastrophic-like rate ≤ old-corpus rate + 0.5 pp, where the
old-corpus rate is measured on the same protocol over the six Phase-1 sources (they are the accepted baseline).
